pages.title: Axiom Toggle
pages.text: A switch that adopts or rejects an axiom. Flip it and the local truths rearrange; some things become provable, others not. It moves with a satisfying click, like choosing between Euclidean and hyperbolic geometry.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside the proof I found switches wired to the axiom lamps. Each one admitted or denied a single postulate. Solving the room meant choosing a consistent set.
